a.lede: The folks behind Wikipedia say that an extreme decision in either direction could threaten the open web.
a.title: The Wikimedia Foundation weighs in on the NYT's case against OpenAI

b.lede: The Wikimedia Foundation is staking out a middle ground in a group of landmark AI copyright cases, pushing courts to legally protect large language models (LLMs) training on copyrighted work - but not chatbots regurgitating that work to users. An overly black-and-white ruling, it says, could either deprive Wikipedians of useful AI-based tools or endanger […]
b.title: Wikipedia’s operator says a bad AI copyright ruling could threaten the open web
